verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you seven principles that prevent decline.
Listen and apply your mind well …

verses.pali: katame ca, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
verses.english: And what are the seven principles that prevent decline?

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na kammārāmā bhavissanti, na kammaratā, na kammārāmataṁ anuyuttā; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: As long as the mendicants don’t relish work, loving it and liking to relish it, they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na bhassārāmā bhavissanti …pe…
verses.english: As long as they don’t enjoy talk …

verses.pali: na pāpicchā bhavissanti na pāpikānaṁ icchānaṁ vasaṁ gatā …
verses.english: they don’t have corrupt wishes, falling under the sway of corrupt wishes …

verses.pali: na pāpamittā bhavissanti na pāpasahāyā na pāpasampavaṅkā …
verses.english: they don’t have bad friends, companions, and associates …

verses.pali: na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṁ āpajjissanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: they don’t stop half-way after achieving some trifling distinction, they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī”ti.
verses.english: As long as these seven principles that prevent decline last among the mendicants, and as long as the mendicants are seen following them, they can expect growth, not decline.”
